passives: Saga-Oath Blood: Skeld Iron Tempest gains Oathstorm when its controller choices express Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds source-culture law through rune-storm ground; Earth myth is only the later echo.
lore: Skeld Iron Tempest is a colossal Asgardian controller from The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Deity is the older source: Asgardian controller office: terrain law, threshold command, battlefield geometry; Yggdrasil: world-tree roots, nine-world crossings, wyrd memory.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source deity, not a costume: Skeld Iron Tempest shows storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.. Role silhouette must read as Controller. Materials include dark rune iron, storm steel, ash wood, wolf fur, raven feather shadow, oath red wax, bone white. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid cartoon Viking, generic horned helmet cosplay, clean chrome, sci-fi power armor, glowing UI runes, blocky hammer mech.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Skeld Iron Tempest — Oath-Ring Cleave Vector
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Asgardian source-culture damage at range 4; generate Momentum and a small Oathstorm gain when used from rune-storm ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as rune iron, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, stormsteel mail, blackwinter scars.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Rune-Thunder Technique — Field Rewrite
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to moves enemies, rewrites terrain pressure, and delays high-threat actions through source-culture law. Builds Oathstorm only when the player uses rune-storm ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Skeld Iron Tempest: Yggdrasil Root Oath Dominion Grid
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Oathstorm to impose a two-round rule from Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds: moves enemies, rewrites terrain pressure, and delays high-threat actions through source-culture law. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Ragnarok Storm Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Oathstorm, transform nearby terrain into rune-storm ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Skeld Iron Tempest Compass Rune-Iron Oath Axe
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through rune-storm ground. Visual: rune iron, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, stormsteel mail, blackwinter scars.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Skeld Iron Tempest Stormsteel Wolf-Cloak Mail
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Skeld Iron Tempest Yggdrasil Thunder-Root Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Oathstorm and unlocks a mastery branch for Bifrost Stormstride, Valkyrie Witness Counter, and Carve the Fallen Name. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: reshape terrain and deny enemy plans
